ideas.title: Investigating Minnesota's Medicaid Program
ideas.description: This story would investigate the alleged fraud in Minnesota's Medicaid program and the Trump administration's decision to withhold funding.
questions: What is the extent of the alleged fraud in Minnesota's Medicaid program?
How will the Trump administration's decision to withhold funding affect the state's Medicaid program?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud in Minnesota's Medicaid program and shed light on the Trump administration's handling of the situation.
